column1: # Lemurian ship departure: the party leaves Gondowan and sets course for Lemuria.

column3: This is it! We're really\nleaving Gondowan!\nWe're going to sea!{end_wait}
There isn't a map\nthat shows where we're\ngoing next.{end_wait}
When I left Imil,\nI never imagined I'd\ntravel this far.{end_wait}
Once we find {actor_name:6},\ndo you think we'll\nfinally go home?{end_now}
I hope you're right.\nI'd like to see Vale\nagain someday.{end_wait}
Maybe not. There's\nstill so much we\ndon't understand.{end_wait}
And Lemuria, {actor_name:2}?\nWe promised Babi\nwe'd find it.{end_wait}
I'd like to see it\nfor myself. Even the\nold maps are silent.{end_wait}
We must find {actor_name:6}.\nShould we do that\nbefore seeking Lemuria?{end_now}
Then we'll find a way\nto help {actor_name:6} and\nBabi both.{end_wait}
We've crossed a sea,\nbut never in a ship\nquite like this one.{end_wait}
Kraden wanted me to\nsee the sea. Well,\nI've seen plenty now!{end_wait}
Those waves look rough.\nCan this ship really\ncarry us through?{end_now}
Then I'll trust you.\nBut let's keep watch\non the weather.{end_wait}
At least we're agreed\nthere's some danger.\nWe'll be careful.{end_wait}
{actor_name:6} is out there.\nWe won't leave her\nbehind.{end_wait}
